WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of the grove shield
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: The caster traces a green chalk ring and wakes the old ward in the altar. A one-way shield closes over the grove for a day, stopping incoming hostile ground and aerial projectiles—including arcane missiles—while letting allied shots pass freely. Each blocked shot spends one charge; ritual strength raises the charge count.
